name: Morning Star
theme: Fallen light, the first refusal, the pride that chose its own fall. The Luciferian archetype.

stages.name: Four Seals: The Mark
stages.desc: Four seals still bind the Morning Star. Its first gifts are given.

stages.name: Three Seals: The First Break
stages.desc: The first seal breaks. Something inside begins to answer.

stages.name: Two Seals: The Falling
stages.desc: Half-bound now. The pride beneath the Morning Star makes itself heard.

stages.name: One Seal: The Final Threshold
stages.desc: Only the last seal remains. Everything within presses against it.

stages.name: Zero Seals: Unbound
stages.desc: The Morning Star walks free. The sky itself knows the one who bears this soul.
